A '''transponder micro-beacon''' was a subdermal implant that allowed individuals to be tracked through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nial Pedrin]] had one implanted in his left arm when he believed that he would be the target of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] kidnapping attempt.]<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|Desperate Measures}}</ref>
